title: The Case of the Muddy Bootprints
story: Wren stepped out for lunch on Tuesday and came back to a trail of mud across the library's freshly waxed floor, and a soggy book about whales on the returns cart. Five patrons came by that afternoon, each at a different time, in different boots, bound for a different section. The prints have the deep ridged tread of rubber boots. "Mud," Wren whispers, "on my wax." Who tracked in the mud?

texts: Nico browsed either the maps or the travel section.
The patron in hiking boots came by earlier than the patron in the history section.
The patron who came by at 2:30 p.m. is neither Greta nor Oscar.
Of Greta and the patron in rubber boots, one came by at 1:00 p.m. and the other came by at 2:30 p.m.
Of the patron in the history section and the patron in the poetry section, one came by at 1:30 p.m. and the other came by at 3:00 p.m.
The patron in snow boots came by at neither 1:30 p.m. nor 3:00 p.m.
The five patrons were the patron who came by at 3:00 p.m., Oscar, the patron in hiking boots, Nico, and the patron in the travel section.
Of the patron in work boots and the patron who came by at 3:00 p.m., one is Pearl and the other is Greta.
